headerDisplay: Shows ecobee Smart Security as a security system in Apple Home (arm Stay / Away, disarm, alarm state). Unofficial: uses the same ecobee cloud as the app.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Home app.

refreshToken.title: Refresh token
refreshToken.description: Filled in when you sign in above. Only needed again if ecobee signs the plugin out (password change, 'sign out everywhere').

homeId.title: Home ID
homeId.description: Only needed if the account has more than one home; the log lists them.

pollInterval.title: Check every (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to read the armed state, so changes made in the ecobee app or at the keypad show up in Apple Home.

offerNight.title: Offer Night
offerNight.description: Adds Night to the Home app, for automations or Siri that use it. ecobee has no Night mode, so Night arms Stay; the Home app keeps showing Night until the state changes.

alarmTrigger.title: Show "Alarm triggered"

oneOf.title: As soon as ecobee opens an incident, during the entry delay (like the ecobee app)
Only once the entry delay runs out without a disarm

alarmTrigger.description: ecobee opens an incident as soon as a door or sensor trips while armed. The second option waits out the entry delay, so automations on Alarm triggered don't fire while you're disarming. Smoke alarms always show at once.
